en: Vintage black‑and‑white view along a riverside promenade with a wooden fence in the foreground, looking across the Mur river toward the historic center of Graz. Large late‑19th‑century buildings line the riverbank, with church towers rising among them. Behind the city is a steep hill crowned with fortification buildings and a prominent clock tower on the slope. Printed caption text at the top left reads "Graz. Mur, Schloßberg".
